about: Key numbers from the netting research, saved Nov 28, 2026. See findings.md for context and sources. Not used by the site.

need.basis: 180 lb, 5 ft 10 in, age 30, man, hard work: Mifflin-St Jeor x 1.725

alewife.runTiming: early May to early June; about 80% of a run passes in roughly two weeks

catchShareModel.formula: share per net = e x min(reach / width, 0.75) x min(1, net height / water depth); n nets set apart: 1 - (1 - share)^n

records.name: Fore River fyke comparison (smelt, tidal)
records.e: 0.125 or more (0.155 if wings angled; up to 0.25-0.31 if water deeper than the 1.2 m net)

runs.note: 2014 was with poor fish passage; 2018-2024 rounded ('nearly' or 'almost'); a Passamaquoddy biologist said in 2025 the trend is down
2025 is a newspaper report after fishway work at Meddybemps; the Fishing tab still uses 58,000
no access to upper spawning grounds

eastBayBrookSmeltPerNight.net: 4 x 4 ft frame, six 2.5 ft hoops, 1/4 in mesh, about 75% of the channel

cobscookFyke2012.nets: 1.2 m high, 9.1 m and 18.3 m wings, 2.5 cm mesh; 2 nets per set; median set about 3 h

suggestedPurchase.heightFt: at least the high-tide water depth, about 4
